page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. It features 54 dedicated vCPUs combined with 480 GB of system memory, providing approximately 8.89 GB of RAM per vCPU core. Hardware acceleration is driven by eight NVIDIA P100 GPUs offering a total of 128 GB of video memory.

The instance integrates 3779 GB of local SSD storage to support workloads requiring low latency direct disk access. Networking capabilities are configured with a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfers across cluster environments.

This hardware footprint combines significant graphics memory, dedicated CPU compute cores, and high memory capacity into a single node. The inclusion of eight discrete GPUs alongside attached local SSD storage makes this server appropriate for deep learning model training, parallel matrix compute, scientific simulations, and complex GPU-bound data processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for high-performance computing and parallel workloads. Running on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture, it provides 54 dedicated vCPUs alongside 480 GB of system RAM, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.89 GB per vCPU. The server is equipped with eight NVIDIA P100 GPUs delivering 128 GB of aggregate VRAM, enabling hardware acceleration for compute-heavy applications. Local storage comprises 3779 GB of SSD capacity for high-throughput disk access, backed by a 25 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The dense allocation of multi-GPU resources, system memory, and direct local storage yields strong hardware density for multi-GPU execution models. The instance is suited for deep learning training, large-scale scientific modeling, complex data processing pipelines, and parallel compute acceleration.
